note: USFS (Custer Gallatin NF, Bozeman Ranger District) campground on the east side of the Bridger Mountains, 22 mi north of Bozeman on MT-86, ~6400 ft. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated April 2026) confirms 12 sites, $10 (charged 6/1-9/15), 30-ft average spur, vault toilets; added no potable water and the 'All Year Weather Dependent' season.
